message.content: I wake up at six every morning, same time every day. I eat some yoghurt, then I get dressed and ride my bike to the bakery. The ride takes about twenty minutes, and I usually listen to the radio while I go. I work the morning shift, so I’m there by seven. My job is mostly routine—labeling the bread trays, wrapping the loaves, and cleaning the counter. I don’t have many people to talk to, but I like the quiet. Sometimes I hear the voice when I’m working, but I just try to ignore it. It’s not loud, just… there. I don’t know what it means, but it doesn’t bother me too much.
